title: ELICITING HUMAN PREFERENCES WITH LANGUAGE MODELS
reasoning: The paper uses 'moral reasoning' as one of its three primary domains for evaluating its preference elicitation framework (GATE). It explicitly benchmarks how well the model can align with human judgments on moral scenarios (e.g., the ethics of stealing bread) and uses specific ethical frameworks like Kantianism and Utilitarianism to simulate various personas in its experiments.
